title: Cyberpunk Demon Citadel
description: A vibrant cyberpunk scene shows a woman in a blue crop top and shorts kneeling in the foreground, taking a selfie with a glowing smartphone while holding a large glowing hammer. To her left, a pink-haired woman in pink armor aims a pistol; to her right, another woman in a pink dress lounges on a draped couch. Behind them looms a giant green radioactive wolf-monster with one large eye and a colossal demonic castle with glowing eyes and smokestacks under a fiery red and pink sky.
prompt: A dramatic cyberpunk scene featuring a woman in blue sportswear kneeling and taking a selfie with a glowing smartphone while holding a large glowing hammer. To her left a pink-haired warrior in pink armor aims a gun, to her right a woman in a pink dress lounges on a luxurious pink couch. In the background a massive toxic green one-eyed wolf monster drips green slime beside a huge demonic castle with glowing eyes, smokestacks, and flames. Dramatic red and pink apocalyptic sky, neon colors, vibrant digital painting style.
